title: soso (with Ozuna)
release_date_note: Spotify deluxe edition; Shazam inherits original album date

songwriting.textual_reading: The transcription retains the English pain-relief refrain and portions of the original Omah Lay text while adding Spanish passages credited in performance to Ozuna. The Spanish text changes the apparent focus toward flirtation and relational attraction; a bilingual check is needed before a confident thematic comparison.

simple_lines_musicality.hypothesis: The comparison tests whether a fixed hook changes function when surrounded by another language and performer. Actual arrangement and vocal sequencing need both recordings.
